name: A Single-Geometry Benchmark of Vascular-Flow Surrogates
description: Benchmark data, trained models and code for two flow problems with exact analytic solutions: a two-dimensional Poisson problem (Level I) and planar Poiseuille flow in a straight two-dimensional channel (Level II). The data compare supervised deep neural networks (DNNs), physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and hybrid data-physics networks on field accuracy, physical consistency and computational cost. These are Levels I and II of the benchmark reported in "When Accuracy, Conservation, and Cost Disagree: A Single-Geometry Benchmark of Vascular-Flow Surrogates" (Dzonzi, Mishra and Ngoepe).LEVEL I: POISSON PROBLEMResults table (CSV) for DNN and PINN models trained with 10, 50, 100, 200 and 500 labelled points, three random seeds each. Variables: relative L2 error and mean squared error on the training domain and on an enlarged domain, and training time.Provenance record (JSON): training protocol, hardware and software versions.Source code and batch scripts that reproduce the table.LEVEL II: PLANAR POISEUILLE FLOWNine runs (DNN, PINN and hybrid; three seeds each) under the scaled training setup.
